sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for building the deck
sections.what: Brings in the template, chart, cohort, schedule and review helpers, plus the types for run results, project data and synthesis.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: finalizedScanData
sections.title: Keeping only verified values for charts
sections.what: Takes each project's stored snapshot and replaces the key figures (budgets, end dates, reasons, schedule slip) with the run's values only where the check passed. Unverified values stay in the research record but are blanked for charts and the AI summary. Planned duration is removed unless the end date and a start date were verified, and overrun reasons are cleared because none is inferred from a number. Projects without a snapshot are dropped.
sections.why: The comment says unverified values must not silently fill charts or the AI summary.
sections.watch_out: A project missing from the snapshot disappears from the deck without a warning.

sections.name: assembleDeck (part 1)
sections.title: Turning projects into deck rows and slides
sections.what: Checks the AI summary succeeded and there are projects. Converts each project into a row with capacity, costs, delay, end dates, status, reasons, approximation and forecast flags, and records of sources and verification for each figure. Display names such as planned end are copied from their underlying fields. Builds the slides, the deck title and caveat, and places a portfolio chart as the third slide.
sections.why: Likely reason: the caveat and verification labels make the limits of the figures visible to readers.
sections.watch_out: Display names are copied from underlying fields, so a missing underlying field leaves its display label with no source.

sections.name: assembleDeck (part 2)
sections.title: Adding review slides and returning the deck
sections.what: Builds review slides from the numbers alone, so a summary exists even when the AI narrative is thin. Inserts them before the glossary slide, or at position 3 when there is no glossary. Returns the full deck at revision 0 with empty messages and proposals.
sections.why: The comment says numerical review remains available when the model returns a sparse narrative.
sections.watch_out: The fixed fallback position 3 may place the review slides in an odd spot if the template changes.

summary: Builds the first saved slide deck (revision 0) from a finished scan run, including projects, charts, review slides and frozen numbers.
purpose: Creates the deck that the consultant then reviews, edits and exports.
why: The comments say the deck is built from the exact finished computation rather than a fresh database read, and that unverified values must not reach charts or the AI summary. Likely reason: keeps the deck consistent with what the run concluded.
how: 1. For each project in the run result, copy its stored snapshot and replace key figures only where verification passed. Overrun reasons are cleared, and planned duration is removed unless the end date and a start date were verified. Projects without a snapshot are dropped. 2. Check the AI summary succeeded and there are projects. 3. Turn each project into a row with capacity, costs, delay, planned and actual end dates, status, reasons, approximation and forecast flags, and per-field sources and checks. 4. Build the slides, set the title and caveat, and insert a portfolio chart as the third slide. 5. Insert numerical review slides before the glossary, or at position 3 if no glossary exists. 6. Return the deck at revision 0 with empty messages and proposals.
inputs: The finished run result, the stored project snapshots, the AI synthesis result, and the list of anchor project ids.
outputs: A deck object with slides, projects, the caveat text, and empty conversation and proposal lists, at revision 0.
risks: Unverified figures silently become Not available or are left out of charts. The insert positions are fixed numbers, which depend on the template order. The template label in the code names Dairy Projects, a fixed label that does not change for other industries.
debug: If chart values are missing for a project, check that field's verification status in the run result. If the error says completed run inputs and synthesis are required, the synthesis step did not succeed. If a project is absent from the deck, check whether it had a stored snapshot. Legacy runs are skipped on purpose.
